objective: Build Phase 1 foundation and first three cinematic screens of The Department of Extraordinary Things (Case No. 012)
acceptance_criteria: Application starts successfully with Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS
Screen A: Access Terminal with interactive terminal prompt, credential validation, error state, and access transition
Screen B: Case Briefing with confidential case-file layout, metadata, dossier reveal, and Accept action
Screen C: Evidence Archive with 3 inspectable objects (photograph, handwritten document, unidentified artefact) with modals/detail views
Navigation and Framer Motion transitions work smoothly between all three screens with reduced-motion support
Investigation visual identity (dark forest green, charcoal, aged paper, brass accents, archival typography) implemented
Museum design tokens and modular architecture separated and prepared for future phases
Responsive design verified on desktop and mobile viewports with no overflow
Visual assets loaded correctly without external broken hotlinks
TypeScript strict check (tsc --noEmit) and Vite production build (vite build) pass with 0 errors
Comprehensive README documenting setup, commands, architecture, and testing without public birthday spoilers
Visual inspection with browser automation verifying desktop and mobile rendering
non_goals: No premature Phase 2 features (full puzzle system, museum transformation, witness statements, personal audio exhibits)
No birthday-related naming in public repo/README
